title: Parameter Estimation
description: Fits twin parameters by minimizing the mismatch between simulated and measured outputs. Recorded facts — Method: Parameter Estimation; Data: sensor history; Output: fitted parameters. Used by manufacturing, energy, and aerospace teams to keep twins trustworthy for decisions.
demo:
# Parameter Estimation — runnable demo (python3)
# Parameter Estimation - calibration RMSE (python3)
errs=[0.02, -0.01, 0.03, 0.0, -0.02]
tol=0.05
import math
rmse=math.sqrt(sum(e*e for e in errs)/len(errs))
bias=sum(errs)/len(errs)
print("RMSE=%.4f bias=%.4f" % (rmse, bias))
print("CALIBRATED" if rmse <= tol else "RECALIBRATE")
